newsitem.title: GERMANY: BMW - no mid-term plans for staffing changes.
newsitem.headline: BMW - no mid-term plans for staffing changes.

text.p: German carmaker Bayerische Motoren Werke AG (BMW) said on Wednesday it had no plans in the medium term to alter its staff levels significantly at home or abroad.

Management board member Joachim Milberg told reporters in Munich that BMW had actually slightly increased its German-based staff in 1996 and did not plan any drastic changes on staffing in the mid-term.

Milberg also called for additional spending on research in Germany, noting that spending on research and development had dropped to 2.27 percent of gross domestic product in 1995 from 2.87 percent ten years before.
That placed German behind Japan, the U.S. and France, he said.
